title: New DoIt non-retryable patterns need both parameterized test lists updated
answers: Adding a non-retryable error pattern to the DoIt source
Which tests to update when changing get_non_retryable_errors
body:
When adding a pattern to get_non_retryable_errors in doit/source.py, extend two parameterized tests in doit/tests/test_doit_source.py:
- test_non_retryable_errors_includes_pattern: add the pattern string to the parametrize list.
- test_non_retryable_errors_tells_the_customer_to_reconnect_on_a_bad_key: add it too if it is a bad-key pattern, so its message is asserted to contain "reconnect".
Annotate the parametrized arg (`pattern: str`), as a reviewer asked.
